_comment: Runtime configuration for the agent system. Contains NO secrets: a
provider's credential is named here by the GitHub Actions secret that
holds it, never by value. Changing a model or a retry limit must not
require touching workflow logic - that is the whole point of this file.
3. agentlib defaults            - per codebase (hard caps live here and

anthropic._note: Generates text and edits files. Invoked via .ai/bin/invoke_agent.sh.

_note: A System One model: typed questions in, typed answers with calibrated
confidence out. It does NOT generate strings, so it cannot replace a
role that writes code, tests, wiki prose or a commit subject - only
the decision such a role was also being asked to make.

_decisions_note: Typed decision points. Each names a questions file under .ai/questions/,
which carries both the wire payload and the confidence gate that governs
its answer. `enabled: false` makes the caller skip the call and use each
gate's fallback - so turning a decision off is always the conservative
direction, and an expired API key degrades to exactly the behaviour the
system had before this provider existed.
Every one of these was previously either prose parsed out of a model's
final message, or not asked at all.

flake._replaces: nothing - previously every red run cost an attempt

spec_readiness._replaces: nothing - previously an untestable spec was found by spending the budget

manager._why: Prose only, and only on the escalation path. The decision itself is now a typed question (decisions.manager) rather than a sentence parsed out of this model's final message.
_prose_note: MANAGER_RETRY and MANAGER_RESCOPE take a templated reason built from
the decision, its confidence and the trigger - no model call at all.
ESCALATE is the one outcome a human reads before acting, so it is the
one worth paying an Opus call to explain.

test_agent._why: Turning stated acceptance criteria into tests is bounded work against a contract the Director already wrote.

code_agent._why: Bounded implementation against committed tests. Escalates rather than re-deciding architecture.

distiller._why: Adds prose interpretation on top of an already-parsed failure structure. Cheapest tier; optional (see features.distiller_model_pass).

context_maintainer._why: Small targeted wiki edits against a known diff.

telemetry._prices_note: USD per million tokens. Used only to annotate records; an unpriced model records a null cost rather than a guessed one. Update when provider pricing changes.

jev/jev-latest._note: Output tokens are free on this provider's published pricing. Recorded as an explicit 0.0 rather than omitted, because an absent price records a null cost and would make these calls look unmeasured rather than cheap.

_auto_merge_note: features.auto_merge is false and the workflows never set it true. Every agent-authored branch reaches main through a human-approved PR.
